summary: Conviction under Section 302 IPC converted to Section 304 Part II IPC by High Court due to time gap between assault and death; nature of injuries, cause of death (asphyxia), absence of internal organ damage, and advanced age of accused (70–80 years) considered; sentence reduced to undergone; State appeals, arguing brutality and intention; appellate review of sentence quantum, deterrence, and societal conscience; prosecution presented 21 witnesses; injuries to PW-2 and PW-12 grievous, deceased died 15 days post-assault; post-mortem inconclusive on causal link.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding conviction under Section 304 Part II IPC and sentence of imprisonment undergone affirmed.
